annotations.text:
Composition pass

One 20px gutter on every screen. Cards are now white on a sunken page and lifted by shadow, rather than white-on-white behind a hairline that vanished. Radii settled at 22 for section cards, 18 for tiles, 999 for controls.

Navigation

Five slots is the ceiling and the app has six destinations, so the bar floats — inset, rounded, shadowed — and the raised ＋ carries Movement session (AR), Log a meal, Log last night and Add water.

Nutrition, and the honesty problem

Entry goes through Open Food Facts — free, open, no API key, barcode lookup, and the camera is already being added for AR so scanning costs nothing extra. Looked-up figures carry the barcode mark in green; anything the user typed carries a ≈ in amber, the same distinction the dashboard already makes between measured and estimated.

There is deliberately no "net calories" figure: without a basal rate it would be wrong by roughly 1,500 kcal, and the card says so rather than showing a confident number.

Assistant

Reachable from a floating button above the nav on every screen. Replies cite the figures they used, the grounding note sits at the top of the conversation, and the offline state is a tweak on this artboard.
